S THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the petition and urge all the contentions before the concerned Court at the appropriate stage.
Reserving such liberty, the petition stands disposed as withdrawn.

In view of disposal of the petition, I.A.no.1/2023 does not survive for consideration and the same stands disposed of.
Sd/-
